## Checklist

- [ ] If I added or changed user-facing strings, I ran `bash scripts/update-translations.sh` and included the updated `.ts` files.

## Translations

Translations are done in [Weblate](https://hosted.weblate.org/projects/boomaga/boomaga-gui-interface/).
**Please do not translate strings manually** in the `.ts` files or send translations in a PR.
Only run `scripts/update-translations.sh` so the catalogs stay in sync with the source code;
translators will pick up the new strings in Weblate.
